title: Transcription Factors Snail, OVO-1, and OVO-2 Regulate Expression of PcCCE7 Associated with Resistance to Spirodiclofen and Abamectin in Panonychus citri.
authors: Liu, Liu; Pan, Qi; Cui, Yangyang; Chen, Tingyu; Fu, Shijun; Zhang, Wei; Yao, Wanfu; Cong, Lin; Yu, Shijiang; Ran, Chun
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究转录因子Snail、OVO-1/2调控酯酶基因PcCCE7表达介导螨类抗药性，涉及TF-DNA启动子结合但仅用双荧光素酶实验验证，无AI或物理模拟方法，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: Carboxyl/cholinesterases play important roles in detoxification of exogenous compounds in arthropods. In this study, the carboxylesterase gene PcCCE7 was upregulated in a spirodiclofen- and abamectin-resistant field population (ASR) and after exposure to each acaricide. Silencing PcCCE7 reduced CCE activity and increased the susceptibility of Panonychus citri to two acaricides. Molecular docking showed the stable binding of PcCCE7 to both compounds. In vitro assays confirmed that recombinant PcCCE7 can degrade spirodiclofen and abamectin, although only spirodiclofen metabolites were detected. Dual-luciferase assays revealed that transcription factors Snail, OVO-1, and OVO-2 enhance PcCCE7 promoter activity. These results indicate that Snail, OVO-1, and OVO-2 regulate PcCCE7, which contributes to cross-resistance to spirodiclofen and abamectin, providing valuable information for resistance management in P. citri.
abstract_zh: 羧基/胆碱酯酶在节肢动物外源化合物解毒中发挥重要作用。本研究中，羧酸酯酶基因PcCCE7在抗螺螨酯和阿维菌素的田间种群（ASR）中以及暴露于每种杀螨剂后均上调表达。沉默PcCE7降低了CCE活性，并增加了柑橘全爪螨（Panonychus citri）对两种杀螨剂的敏感性。分子对接显示PcCCE7与两种化合物稳定结合。体外实验证实重组PcCCE7可降解螺螨酯和阿维菌素，尽管仅检测到螺螨酯代谢物。双荧光素酶实验揭示转录因子Snail、OVO-1和OVO-2增强PcCCE7启动子活性。这些结果表明，Snail、OVO-1和OVO-2调控PcCCE7，其有助于对螺螨酯和阿维菌素的交叉抗性，为柑橘全爪螨的抗性管理提供了有价值的信息。
